thread_title: S. jonesii 'BLACK LIPS' Greenville Co, SC
breadcrumb: S. jonesii 'BLACK LIPS' Greenville Co, SC

posts.body_html:
When I show friends my small collection, I proudly point to the HCW clone I got from Mike, and tell them that this Sarracenia is extinct in the wild. If it wasn't for dedicated CPers, those genetics would have been lost forever. One of my long-term goals in this hobby is to have a greenhouse someday, and I would like to dedicate at least a portion of the grow area to legally helping keep alive and distribute some of these rare plants so that they continue to persist on this planet. I can't think of better karma than that 

Jul 8, 2015 11:05:25 GMT -5 meizzwang said:
I didn't believe my eyes when I saw this...no photo-shopping, no looking left and right, and then getting out the black magic marker and coloring it in while nobody is looking...this is exactly how the genetics of this plant played out with this clone:it's got BLACK LIPS!

Magic Marker Mike!
